name: Toribi: Prelude
source:
Toribi: Prelude is a pretty clichéd story about a boy (Hum) and a girl (Maria) who are childhood friends. One day, Hum reveals to Maria that soon he will be moving away to the countryside to go to boarding school there, and that the two of them only have seven days together before they will be separated. In this game, you play as Maria in her final week with her best friend.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14660]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Toribi：序章》讲述了一个颇为老套的故事：男孩哈姆与女孩玛丽亚是青梅竹马。有一天，哈姆告诉玛丽亚，他很快就要搬去乡下，在那里的寄宿学校就读，两人只剩七天便要分别。在这款游戏中，你将扮演玛丽亚，度过与挚友相伴的最后一周。

［摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14660]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]］
